scope: Prospective pure transfer control with native56-node geometry/T/ne/rho and complete native41-level O n/nstar/totals. Native HOP LTE EOS/continuum and explicit native H/He perturber densities; unchanged LW atomic and broadening formulas, five native Lobatto angles and native-constant background source. Top zero incoming; LW thermalized lower-boundary and native ghost/formal/profile/constants differences remain explicit. Report all six finite-window contrasts with no result-selected input or adopted model. Prospective LW linear formal solver at the same original native state; compared with native linear-output-only control. No agreement-selected production default. Explicit native Stark-off run populations consumed in full, including measured0.2103percent maximum population response. This isolates paired transfer at the new state; no original-state population equality claim. Prospective explicit He contribution disabled solely at LW elastic-broadening interface, to compare native HI-only damping. Native EOS/He density/continuum/atomic O populations and all remaining formulas retained. No helium abundance or production recipe change. Prospective consumed-table optical centres_and_strengths control: ten source transitions across predeclared six windows, no other transition or energy-level changes. Explicit native table rounding, not fitted offsets/strengths. Fixed populations only; wavelength overrides are not a self-consistent SE atom. Prospective paired transfer at isolated accurate-kernel native populations. Use its complete n/nStar/totals, not original-profile populations; native SE response measured separately. Original HOP background provider, optical source-determined centre/strength controls, He-off broadening diagnostic and linear formal solver retained. No physical/default adoption. Prospective restoration of full positive original-source VDW law derived algebraically from exact DAMP. No width suppression, extra He multiplication, empirical scale or global default change. Law verified on56 states and all five source controls; numerical T domain explicit. Native accurate-kernel full-VDW populations retained, already-vacuum optical centres explicit. Physical/collider/EOS/SE/solar admission remains open.
